en: A colorized panoramic view of a European city with a steep, forested hill dominating the center. On top of the hill stands a fortress-like complex or castle. The city, with red-tiled roofs and several large institutional buildings, spreads around the base of the hill and along a river visible to the right, with bridges and embankments. The style is that of an early 20th‑century printed postcard, with a white border and no visible caption on the image side.
